On the post-earnings conference call, UBS ‌analyst Tim Arcuri asked executives whether Nvidia was looking to give back to shareholders some of the $100 billion cash it was likely to generate this year, because "no matter how good the results have been, the stock hasn't really ​gone up much." In response, Nvidia Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress said the company wanted to keep investing in the AI ecosystem.
